messages:
Maya P.: Quick heads-up — proposing a small pilot cohort (3 ISVs + 2 gateway vendors) to rehearse a joint demo for the marketplace launch. Goal: validate end-to-end onboarding, demo script, and public announcement timing. Thoughts?
Sanjay R.: Love it. Who are the three ISVs you had in mind?
Maya P.: Thinking FlowBridge, ChainForge, and VectorMesh. CNX gateway + SigmaCloud adapter as the gateway vendors.
Alex G.: +1. We should include a short orchestration run (LangChain runner + our gateway) and an indexer test with LlamaIndex. Make sure we exercise model fallback and cold KV cache.
Tess H.: Agree. I'll own the demo script with you @Maya. Need concrete success criteria (latency under X, model fallback triggers, and marketplace install flow).
Maya P.: Success criteria draft: 1) marketplace install completes without manual creds, 2) demo app returns an answer <800ms median (on dedicated instance), 3) end-to-end sign-on and billing metadata present. Open to changes.
Liam C.: For billing metadata, product requires token-level trace in the payload. We'll need the partner adapters to propagate trace headers: `x-rw-customer-id` and `x-orch-request-id`. I'll share sample headers.
Erika N.: Legal/Compliance note: marketing cannot push joint announcement until we have partner-approved copy and SigmaCloud SOW confirms co-marketing. Expect 5–7 business days for legal review.
Sanjay R.: Can we get partners to sign a short sandbox NDA/ok-to-demo form? Prefer minimal friction. @Maya can you draft?
Maya P.: I can draft a one-pager by EOD tomorrow. Also need a single repo with demo assets: helm chart, sample dataset, quickstart, and a short `run_demo.sh`.
Alex G.: I'll seed the repo. Suggest layout: `/helm`, `/scripts/run_demo.sh`, `/prompts/`, `/e2e/verify.sh`. Example run snippet:```
# run_demo.sh
helm upgrade --install demo ./helm/demo --set image.tag=staging
./scripts/wait_ready.sh && ./e2e/verify.sh --check-latency
```
Tess H.: For orchestration, include a short LangChain YAML that exercises tool-calling and an index refresh with LlamaIndex: `index.refresh(true)` so we see cold-start behavior.
Maya P.: Timeline proposal: setup + partner onboarding this week, dry run next Tue, taped rehearsal Thu, announcement freeze next Mon (one week blackout before public). Ok?
Sanjay R.: Works for me. I'll ping FlowBridge and ChainForge PMs.
Liam C.: Ops question — where do we host the staging infra? Prefer Dedicated pool in us-west-2 to match latency targets.
Alex G.: I'll spin a dedicated pool and export creds to the demo repo placeholder (short-lived tokens). Add a note in README about credential rotation.
Erika N.: I'll start the co-marketing checklist: partner logos, quote approvals, press calendar slots. Also adding legal line-item for co-branded landing page.
Tess H.: Need a small smoke test for hardware partner (SigmaCloud): run 3x heavy batches to ensure no OOM on their adapter. I can add an automated test in `/e2e/perf.sh`.
Maya P.: Perfect. Owners: Maya (program + partner comms), Tess (demo script & perf tests), Alex (repo & staging infra), Liam (billing headers & infra config), Erika (legal & marketing). Can everyone confirm?
Sanjay R.: Confirmed.
Alex G.: Confirmed.
Tess H.: Confirmed.
Liam C.: Confirmed.
Erika N.: Confirmed.
OpsBot: Calendar event created: "Tooling Cohort — Partner Demo Rehearsal" Thu 10:00 PT — attendees: Maya P., Tess H., Alex G., Sanjay R., Liam C., Erika N., Partners. Zoom link + staging creds posted to repo once ready.
